Export the provenance of an analysis

Source: R/provenance.R
fev_provenance.Rd

Returns the full provenance record of a fev_stack() – sources with their vintages, the working CRS and resolution, and the ordered log of every operation with the parameters it ran with. Optionally writes it to a YAML file.

Usage

fev_provenance(x, file = NULL)

Arguments

x

A fev_stack object.

file

Optional path. When given, the record is written there as YAML and the record is returned invisibly.

Value

A named list of class fev_provenance. Invisibly when file is given.

Details

This is what makes an analysis replayable. The record is built as the analysis runs, so it reflects the parameters actually used, including defaults the caller never typed.

Examples

r <- terra::rast(nrows = 4, ncols = 4, xmin = 0, xmax = 100,
                 ymin = 0, ymax = 100, crs = "EPSG:2154")
terra::values(r) <- seq_len(16)
s <- fev_stack(fuel = r, crs_work = 2154)
prov <- fev_provenance(s)
prov$crs_work
#> [1] 2154
